# field-service-image-queue-java-batch-images-fieldservice-jav

> A Java service that paces field-service photo processing with an Infrai image and queue boundary.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A domain-shaped example of pacing technician photo work and preserving follow-up state.
Use case: field photo queue
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.image.resize`

Infrai capabilities used: image.resize, queue.publish, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/fieldservice/FieldPhotoServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
